integrity.claim_scope: Exact fourth-order near-diameter tail with strict order-identifying coefficient and distinct smooth-sphere exponent.
integrity.source_scope: Cited sources provide metric and geometric context, not authorship or independent certification of the new theorem.

scientific_limitations: Only round spherical two-orbifolds obtained by finite axial cyclic rotations are covered.
The endpoint asymptotic fixes cyclic order; no uniform remainder in the order is claimed.
Equivalent older treatments under other terminology remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Antipodal distance tails recover cyclic spherical footballs
